Sandbox_PhunServer2_Verbose_tooltip: Tick this for detailed PhunServer2 logging in your console and logs. Applies to every PhunServer2 module.
Sandbox_PhunServer2_RefreshSettingsOnSta: When ticked, refresh sandbox settings from your Sandbox_Vars file at startup. This works around a build bug where settings get cached and later edits are ignored.
Sandbox_PhunServer2_NotificationCountdow: Semicolon separated seconds at which to warn players before a shutdown. For example 300;60;10
Sandbox_PhunServer2_NotificationChime_to: Play a chime alongside each shutdown warning
Sandbox_PhunServer2_QuitDelaySeconds_too: Seconds to wait after the final save before the server quits
